# Precipitation {#sec-precipitation}  

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(mseptools)
library(msepBoundaries)
library(msepBaselineData)
library(tmap)
library(reactable)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)


prcp_monthly <- rast(here::here("data",
                                "precip",
                                "processed",
                                "precip_2025.tif"))
prcp_monthly_in <- prcp_monthly / 25.4
prcp_annual_in <- sum(prcp_monthly_in, na.rm = TRUE)


# map options
# moving the actual ifelse statements before the maps that I do want to be interactive
# because making the faceted ones interactive is not good
# at this point it's only the annual totals, averaged to HUC8,
# that I want to allow to be interactive. Everything else will be plot mode.


# define colors and shapes for ggplots
# 1. Define distinct colors for your 3 basins (replace keys with your actual basin names)
basin_palette <- c(
  "Coastal Streams" = "#583a55",
  "Pascagoula River" = "#d26c3a",
  "Pearl River" = "#82acb2"
)

# 2. 8 high-contrast shape codes (16:circle, 17:triangle, 18:diamond, 15:square, 25:down triangle, 8:star, 3:plus, 4:cross)
shape_palette <- c(16, 17, 18, 15, 25, 8, 3, 4)

```

```{r}
# render the maps interactively or statically
out_format <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.pandoc.to")

# if it's an interactive session, out_format will be NULL from the above command, so do things the html way
if(is.null(out_format)){
  out_format <- "html"
}
```

## Overall Summary  

2025 was normal-to-dry across the Mississippi 
Sound Watershed. In terms of the annual total precipitation received, about 1/3 of the subbasins were within 5% of the 30-year average total. The others ranged about 10-20% lower for their annual totals. The subbasins that were driest were generally in the southern portions of the watershed, whereas the more northern subbasins were closer to the long-term average. See @fig-mapPrcpTotalAndAnomPct and @fig-precipPctDiff in particular for details. 

In terms of monthly totals, May was a little bit wet, particularly in the middle portion of the watershed, and the dry months were September and November. See @fig-mapPrcpMonthlyAnoms.

For a summary table of annual and monthly totals, normals, and % difference from normal, see @tbl-prcpAnoms.


## Supporting Information  


### Annual Precipitation, Averaged to HUC8    

Annual totals were calculated from monthly precipitation data obtained from the PRISM Group at Oregon State University, https://prism.oregonstate.edu which were accessed 29 July 2026.  


#### Maps  

```{r}
# make a spat vector of huc8s for summaries
huc8_vect <- vect(subbasins_full)
prcp_huc8_avg.ann <- extract(prcp_annual_in, huc8_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, bind = TRUE) |> 
  st_as_sf()
```

```{r}
# Annual Total, inches

# make map in plot mode so it stays a tmap object and
# can be used in tmap_arrange to be displayed with other maps

tmap_mode("plot")

m3 <- tm_shape(prcp_huc8_avg.ann) +
  tm_basemap() +
  tm_polygons(fill = "sum",
              fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "brewer.gn_bu"),
              fill_alpha = 0.8,
              fill.free = FALSE,  # make the colors the same in every facet
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "inches",
                                      position = tm_pos_out("right")),
              col = "black",  # polygon outline color
              lwd = 2) 

m3b <- tmap_hydro(m3)
```

```{r}
# Calculate anomalies for 2025


# Pull annual normal and annual 2025 total into a plain data frame
annual_2025 <- as.data.frame(prcp_huc8_avg.ann) %>%
  select(huc8, sum)

annual_normal <- precip_normals_huc8avg %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name, Annual)   # adjust name if your annual normal column is called something else

annual_anomaly <- annual_normal %>%
  left_join(annual_2025, by = "huc8") %>%
  mutate(anomaly = sum - Annual,
         pct_of_normal = sum / Annual * 100,
         diff_from_normal = pct_of_normal - 100)

# Attach back to geometry for mapping
prcp_anomaly_ann_sv <- terra::merge(prcp_huc8_avg.ann[, "huc8"], 
                              annual_anomaly[, c("huc8", "basin_name", "subbasin_name", "anomaly", "pct_of_normal", "diff_from_normal")], 
                              by = "huc8")
```

```{r}
# Anomaly Time Series


# first make the time series of anomalies
norms <- precip_normals_huc8avg |> 
  sf::st_drop_geometry() |> 
  select(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name, 
         annual_normal = Annual)

anoms_ts <- precip_yearly_huc8avg |> 
  left_join(norms) |> 
  mutate(anomaly = prcp_inches - annual_normal,
         pct_of_normal = prcp_inches / annual_normal * 100,
         pct_diff_from_normal = pct_of_normal - 100)
```

```{r}
# make anomaly maps in plot mode
max_abs <- max(abs(as.data.frame(prcp_anomaly_ann_sv)$anomaly), na.rm = TRUE)
max_pct <- max(abs(as.data.frame(prcp_anomaly_ann_sv)$pct_of_normal), na.rm = TRUE)

tmap_mode("plot")

# precip as % of normal
m41 <- tm_shape(prcp_anomaly_ann_sv) +
  tm_basemap() +
  tm_polygons(fill = "diff_from_normal",
              fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "brewer.rd_bu",
                                     midpoint = 0,
                                     limits = c(-max_pct, max_pct),
                                    label.format = list(fun = function(x) sprintf("%+g%%", x), digits = 0, text.separator = "to")),
              fill_alpha = 0.8,
              fill.free = FALSE,
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "% difference \nfrom normal",
                                      position = tm_pos_out("right")),
              col = "black",
              lwd = 2) 

m41b <- tmap_hydro(m41)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mapPrcpTotalAndAnomPct
#| fig-cap: "Maps of 2025 precipitation, averaged to the HUC8 level. Left: Total precipitation, inches. Right: Difference from normal precipitation, as a percent (e.g. -5% means precipitation was 5% lower than normal). Darker colors indicate values further from the long-term average (blue = more precipitation than normal; red = less)."

# allow this one to be interactive
if (out_format == "html") {
  message("Setting tmap mode to 'view'")
  tmap_mode("view")
} else {
  message("Setting tmap mode to 'plot'")
  tmap_mode("plot")
}

tmap_arrange(m3b, m41b, sync = TRUE)
```



#### Time Series Graphs  

In the HTML version of this document, the following time series graphs are interactive. Hovering over a line shows which subbasin it represents, and hovering over a point shows more information about the yearly total.

##### Total Precipitation  

```{r}
# 1. Build an HTML tooltip column containing all dataframe variables
precip_yearly_huc8avg$tooltip_txt <- sprintf(
  "<b>Basin:</b> %s<br><b>Subbasin:</b> %s<br><b>Year:</b> %d<br><b>Precip Total:</b> %.1f",
  precip_yearly_huc8avg$basin_name,
  precip_yearly_huc8avg$subbasin_name,
  precip_yearly_huc8avg$year,
  precip_yearly_huc8avg$prcp_inches
)
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-tsPrcpAnnualTotals
#| fig-cap: "Time series of annual precipitation total (inches) by HUC-8 (subbasin). Each line represents a subbasin."

p <- ggplot(precip_yearly_huc8avg,
       aes(x = year, y = prcp_inches,
           group = subbasin_name)) +
  # Interactive line (shows subbasin_name on line hover)
  geom_line_interactive(
    aes(data_id = subbasin_name, tooltip = subbasin_name),
    col = "gray40",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  # Interactive points (shows full data frame column details on point hover)
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(data_id = subbasin_name, tooltip = tooltip_txt),
    size = 0.1,
    col = "gray40"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Precipitation Total (inches)")


if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  girafe(
    ggobj = p,
    options = list(
    # Styling for the hovered line & points
    opts_hover(css = "stroke: #0072B2; stroke-width: 2.5px; fill: none; r: 4px; cursor: pointer;"),
    # Styling for non-hovered lines (fades them out)
    opts_hover_inv(css = "opacity: 0.15;"),
    # Tooltip styling
    opts_tooltip(css = "background-color: white; color: black; padding: 8px; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); font-family: sans-serif; font-size: 12px;")
  )
  )
} else {
  p
}
```

##### Boxplot time series  

Each box represents a single year; overlaid points represent subbasins.  

```{r}
# more formatting, based on data frame and the colors/shapes defined above


# 3. Build the lookup table dataframe
style_lookup <- anoms_ts %>%
  distinct(basin_name, subbasin_name) %>%
  arrange(basin_name, subbasin_name) %>%
  group_by(basin_name) %>%
  mutate(
    color = basin_palette[basin_name],
    shape = shape_palette[1:n()]  # Restarts shape sequence (1, 2, 3...) for each basin group
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Create named vectors for ggplot scales
subbasin_colors <- setNames(style_lookup$color, style_lookup$subbasin_name)
subbasin_shapes <- setNames(style_lookup$shape, style_lookup$subbasin_name)


# get things in a good order for the legend
ordered_subbasins <- style_lookup %>% 
  arrange(basin_name, subbasin_name) %>% 
  pull(subbasin_name)

# 2. Convert subbasin_name in your dataset to a factor with this specific order
anoms_ts <- anoms_ts %>%
  mutate(subbasin_name = factor(subbasin_name, levels = ordered_subbasins))
```


```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplotPrcpPctDiffBW
#| fig-cap: "Boxplot representing the distribution of rainfall totals by subbasin by year. Each box represents a year; each overlaid point represents a subbasin.  Whiskers extend to the quantiles +/- 1.5 times the IQR."

ggplot(anoms_ts,
       aes(x = as.factor(year),
           y = pct_diff_from_normal)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45,
                                   hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = "Year", 
       y = "% difference from normal")
```


Here is the same plot, but with points identifiable to subbasin.

```{r}
#| label: fig-boxplotPrcpPctDiffColors
#| fig-cap: "Boxplot representing the distribution of rainfall totals by subbasin by year. Each box represents a year; each overlaid point represents a subbasin. Each color represents a basin, with shapes within colors representing the subbasins. Whiskers extend to the quantiles +/- 1.5 times the IQR."

ggplot(anoms_ts,
       aes(x = as.factor(year),

       shape = "Subbasin")
```



### Monthly Precipitation  

Monthly data are from the PRISM Group at Oregon State University, https://prism.oregonstate.edu and were accessed 29 July 2026. They are again averaged to HUC8. Monthly normals are also from the PRISM group, and were compiled in the [`msepBaselineData`](https://github.com/CMEP-MS/msepBaselineData) R package.

```{r}
# make a spat vector of huc8s for summaries
huc8_vect <- vect(subbasins_full)
prcp_huc8_avg <- extract(prcp_monthly_in, huc8_vect, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE, bind = TRUE)
```

```{r}
month_cols <- names(prcp_huc8_avg)
month_cols <- month_cols[!(month_cols %in% c("huc8", "name"))]  # drop the ID column, keep only month value columns
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mapPrcpMonthlyTotals
#| fig-cap: "Map of monthly precipitation totals (inches), averaged to the HUC-8 (subbasin) level."

tmap_mode("plot")

m7 <- tm_shape(prcp_huc8_avg) +
  tm_basemap() +
  tm_polygons(fill = month_cols,
              fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "brewer.gn_bu"),
              fill_alpha = 0.8,
              fill.free = FALSE,  # make the colors the same in every facet
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "inches",
                                      position = tm_pos_out("right")),
              col = "black",  # polygon outline color
              lwd = 2) +
  # change the layout
  tm_facets(ncol = 4, nrow = 3) +
  tm_title("Precipitation by Month, 2025")

tmap_hydro(m7)
```



#### Monthly Anomalies  

From long-term climate normals, as provided by the PRISM Climate Group at Oregon State University and processed into the `msepBaselineData` package's `precip_normals_huc8avg` dataset.  

```{r}
# Pull attributes out of the SpatVector as a plain data frame (drop geometry for the join)
huc8_2025 <- as.data.frame(prcp_huc8_avg) %>%
  select(huc8, Jan.2025:Dec.2025) %>%
  pivot_longer(-huc8, names_to = "month", values_to = "precip_2025") %>%
  mutate(month = sub("\\..*", "", month))   # "Jan.2025" -> "Jan"

normals_long <- precip_normals_huc8avg %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name, Jan:Dec) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name), 
               names_to = "month", 
               values_to = "normal")

anomalies <- normals_long %>%
  left_join(huc8_2025, by = c("huc8", "month")) %>%
  mutate(anomaly = precip_2025 - normal,
         pct_of_normal = precip_2025 / normal * 100,
         pct_diff_from_normal = pct_of_normal - 100)
```

```{r}
# anomalies wide now contains % diff from normal, not raw anomaly
anomalies_wide <- anomalies %>%
  select(huc8:month, pct_diff_from_normal) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = pct_diff_from_normal)

# reorder columns to calendar order (pivot_wider alphabetizes otherwise)
month_order <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")
anomalies_wide <- anomalies_wide %>% select(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name, all_of(month_order))

# attach to polygon geometry (attribute join, not spatial join)
prcp_anomaly_sv <- terra::merge(prcp_huc8_avg[, "huc8"], anomalies_wide, by = "huc8")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-mapPrcpMonthlyAnoms
#| fig-cap: "Map of monthly precipitation difference from normal, as a percent (i.e. '-10' can be read as '10% below normal'), averaged to the HUC-8 (subbasin) level."

month_cols <- names(prcp_anomaly_sv)
month_cols <- month_cols[!(month_cols %in% c("huc8", "basin_name", "subbasin_name"))]

# make the scale symmetric around 0 so the diverging midpoint is meaningful
max_abs <- max(abs(as.data.frame(prcp_anomaly_sv)[, month_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)

tmap_mode("plot")
m8 <- tm_shape(prcp_anomaly_sv) +
  tm_basemap() +
  tm_polygons(fill = month_cols,
              fill.scale = tm_scale(values = "brewer.rd_bu",
                                     midpoint = 0,
                                     limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
                                     label.format = list(fun = function(x) sprintf("%+g%%", x), digits = 0, text.separator = "to")),
              fill_alpha = 0.8,
              fill.free = FALSE,
              fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "% difference \nfrom normal",
                                      position = tm_pos_out("right")),
              col = "black",
              lwd = 2) +
  tm_facets(ncol = 4, nrow = 3) +
  tm_title("Precipitation Anomaly by Month, 2025")

tmap_hydro(m8)
```

#### Table of Anomalies  

```{r}
month_order <- c("Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec")

# Helper to format cells into two rows:
# Top: 2025 total (bold in HTML)
# Bottom: Normal (% diff from normal)
# Note: Change %+.1f%% to %.1f%% below if you prefer not to show a '+' sign on positive values
format_precip_cell <- function(p25, norm, pct_diff, html = TRUE) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(p25) | is.na(norm) | is.na(pct_diff),
    NA_character_,
    if (html) {
      sprintf(
        "<b>%.1f</b><br><span style='font-size: 0.85em;'>%.1f (%+.1f%%)</span>",
        p25, norm, pct_diff
      )
    } else {
      sprintf("%.1f\n%.1f (%+.1f\\%%)", p25, norm, pct_diff)
    }
  )
}

# Build monthly numeric % diff & formatted display columns
monthly_prep <- anomalies %>%
  mutate(
    disp_html = format_precip_cell(precip_2025, normal, pct_diff_from_normal, html = TRUE),
    disp_pdf  = format_precip_cell(precip_2025, normal, pct_diff_from_normal, html = FALSE)
  )

monthly_pct_wide <- monthly_prep %>%
  select(huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name, month, pct_diff_from_normal) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = pct_diff_from_normal)

monthly_html_wide <- monthly_prep %>%
  select(huc8, month, disp_html) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = disp_html) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_html"), all_of(month_order))

monthly_pdf_wide <- monthly_prep %>%
  select(huc8, month, disp_pdf) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = disp_pdf) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_pdf"), all_of(month_order))

# Build annual numeric % diff & formatted display columns
annual_prep <- annual_anomaly %>%
  transmute(
    huc8,
    Annual_pct  = diff_from_normal,
    Annual_html = format_precip_cell(sum, Annual, diff_from_normal, html = TRUE),
    Annual_pdf  = format_precip_cell(sum, Annual, diff_from_normal, html = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  rename(Annual = Annual_pct)

# Combine into final table dataset
anomaly_table <- monthly_pct_wide %>%
  left_join(annual_prep, by = "huc8") %>%
  left_join(monthly_html_wide, by = "huc8") %>%
  left_join(monthly_pdf_wide, by = "huc8") %>%
  select(
    huc8, basin_name, subbasin_name,
    Annual, all_of(month_order),
    Annual_html, all_of(paste0(month_order, "_html")),
    Annual_pdf, all_of(paste0(month_order, "_pdf"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(basin_name, huc8)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-prcpAnoms
#| tbl-cap: "Precipitation totals and anomalies by HUC-8 for all months and the annual total of 2025 (inches). Top value in each cell is the 2025 total; bottom values are the 30-year normal followed by the percent difference from normal in parentheses. In the interactive table, clicking a month or Annual column header sorts by percent difference from normal. Cells are colored by percent difference from normal; wetter in blue and drier in red, and larger values are darker colors."


if (out_format == "html") {
  #### reactable version
  
  month_max_abs <- max(abs(as.matrix(anomaly_table[, month_order])), na.rm = TRUE)
  annual_max_abs <- max(abs(anomaly_table$Annual), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  month_pal <- col_numeric(
    palette = c("#B2182B", "#F7F7F7", "#2166AC"),
    domain = c(-month_max_abs, month_max_abs)
  )
  
  annual_pal <- col_numeric(
    palette = c("#B2182B", "#F7F7F7", "#2166AC"),
    domain = c(-annual_max_abs, annual_max_abs)
  )
  
  # Text color: switch to near-white once a cell is dark enough to need it
  # user can modify the threshold value - I played with 0.65 and 0.7
  # and black over those was just too hard to read; 0.6 seems like a good changepoint to white
  text_color <- function(value, max_abs, threshold = 0.6) {
    if (is.na(value)) return("black")
    frac <- abs(value) / max_abs   # 0 (near zero) -> 1 (extreme)
    if (frac > threshold) "#F7F7F7" else "black"
  }
  
anomaly_colDef <- function(col_name, pal, max_abs, is_annual = FALSE, is_jan = FALSE) {
    html_col <- paste0(col_name, "_html")
    
    colDef(
      html = TRUE,
      # Render formatted HTML while keeping underlying values numeric for native sorting & coloring
      cell = function(value, index) {
        anomaly_table[[html_col]][index]
      },
      headerStyle = if (is_annual) {
        list(
          borderLeft = "2px solid #4D4D4D",
          borderRight = "2px solid #4D4D4D"
        )
      } else if (is_jan) {
        list(borderLeft = "8px solid white")
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      style = function(value) {
        base <- if (is.na(value)) {
          list()
        } else {
          list(
            background = pal(value),
            color = text_color(value, max_abs)
          )
        }
        if (is_annual) {
          c(base, list(
            borderLeft = "2px solid #4D4D4D",
            borderRight = "2px solid #4D4D4D"
          ))
        } else if (is_jan) {
          c(base, list(
            borderLeft = "8px solid white"
          ))
        } else {
          base
        }
      }
    )
  }
  
  # Hide helper display columns from rendering
  hidden_cols <- setNames(
    lapply(c("Annual_html", paste0(month_order, "_html"), "Annual_pdf", paste0(month_order, "_pdf")), 
           function(x) colDef(show = FALSE)),
    c("Annual_html", paste0(month_order, "_html"), "Annual_pdf", paste0(month_order, "_pdf"))
  )
  
  ### TABLE ITSELF ###
  
  reactable(
    anomaly_table,
    striped = FALSE,
    sortable = TRUE,
    groupBy = "basin_name",
    defaultExpanded = TRUE,
    columns = c(
      list(
        huc8 = colDef(name = "HUC8", sticky = "left"),
        basin_name = colDef(
          name = "Basin",
          sticky = "left",
          style = list(fontWeight = "bold")
        ),
        subbasin_name = colDef(
          name = "Subbasin",
          sticky = "left",
          style = list(borderRight = "8px solid white"),
          headerStyle = list(borderRight = "8px solid white")
        ),
        Annual = anomaly_colDef("Annual", annual_pal, annual_max_abs, is_annual = TRUE)
      ),
      setNames(
        lapply(month_order, function(x) {
          anomaly_colDef(x, month_pal, month_max_abs, is_jan = (x == "Jan"))
        }),
        month_order
      ),
      hidden_cols
    ),
    defaultColDef = colDef(align = "center"),
    defaultPageSize = 20
  )
  
  
} else {
  # static knitr::kable version
  anomaly_table_pdf <- anomaly_table %>%
    select(basin_name, huc8, subbasin_name, Annual_pdf, all_of(paste0(month_order, "_pdf"))) %>%
    mutate(across(c(Annual_pdf, all_of(paste0(month_order, "_pdf"))), ~ linebreak(.x, align = "c")))
  
  kable(anomaly_table_pdf,
        format = "latex",
        booktabs = TRUE,
        col.names = c("Basin", "HUC8", "Subbasin", "Annual", month_order),
        escape = FALSE) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "scale_down"),
                  full_width = FALSE) %>%
    collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "middle")
}
```
